text:
alex.k: heads-up — i just merged an event-schema tweak for embeddings that renames tokens_used -> token_count (PR #4821). felt harmless but it looks like the attribution job is now splitting gen vs embed tokens incorrectly.

maria_p: ah, was that the change that also changed the top-level `model_type` values?

alex.k: yup — model_type values stayed the same, just the token field name. i updated the schema doc but forgot the mapping in the billing transform. my bad.

cheng: quick question — is this only affecting historical rebuilds or streaming reads?

alex.k: mostly streaming reads / real-time attribution. historical backfills use the old parser that still expects tokens_used, so they’re fine for now. the real-time pipeline (attrib-service -> token-aggregator) fails to find tokens so attrib falls back to counting 0 for embeds.

samir: that explains the drop in embed cost on the dashboard. noticed a 40% decrease in embed token spend at ~09:10 UTC.

jess-oncall: flagging impacts to the cost dashboard and SLO alerting. can we do a hotfix mapping in token-aggregator to accept either field?

alex.k: yeah plan A = quick patch that reads token_count || tokens_used. small change, tests, deploy. plan B = rollback PR #4821 if hotfix isn't safe.

cheng: i can take the hotfix. will open a tiny PR and tag you. do we need to update the protobuf/event contract too?

alex.k: protobuf updated in PR but we didn't bump the consumer proto dep for token-aggregator. that's why the field isn't seen. so two fixes: 1) consumer proto bump, 2) tolerant parsing.

samir: ordering matters — bump first or tolerant parse first? if we bump consumer proto without runtime change, it might break (missing field name mismatch). safer to deploy tolerant parser first, then bump proto and remove tolerance in next cleanup.

jess-oncall: +1 for tolerant-first. also: add a smoke-check on the cost dashboard that verifies embed token counts > 0 for a minute after deploy.

alex.k: agreed. cheng, can you open PR with:

```
// token-aggregator/parse.go (pseudo)
func parseTokens(ev Event) int {
  if ev.TokenCount != nil { return *ev.TokenCount }
  return ev.TokensUsed
}
```

alex.k: tag me and samir for a quick review. i'll prepare the deploy playbook and a rollback note.

cheng: creating PR now — will include unit + small integration test against sample payloads. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/token-aggregator/pull/4893

samir: pulling the deploy queue open window 10m after merge. will watch dashboard and alerts. if embed_token_rate < 50% baseline, rollback.

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #4893 — integration tests ok. queued for deploy window. :rocket:

jess-oncall: thanks. owners: alex.k (schema), cheng (hotfix PR), samir (deploy/watch). i'll update the runbook and add the smoke query to dashboards.

alex.k: one more FYI — tagging analytics-team for a follow-up to reconcile the temporary discrepancy in last-hour billing slice. @maria_p @analytics-team please check once we stabilize.

maria_p: will do a reconciliation job and post numbers here after deploy.

alex.k: timeline: hotfix PR in progress (15–30m), deploy + watch (30–60m). i'll post final status here.

cheng: PR submitted, requesting review from alex.k and samir. changelog included.

alex.k: reviewing now. thanks all. :thumbsup:
